description: Server-callable functions that take an actor and do not reach an engagement, tax-year, case or return-version scope check, each with a reviewed reason. Checked by src/tests-db/functionAccessInventory.db.test.ts against a database with every migration and proposal applied; a new unlisted function fails the test. Generated 2026-10-31 (Block 79).

categories.TENANT_TAX_CONTENT: Tenant-wide tax content (sources, rule sets and their tests, form rules, return templates, categories, document-request templates, the service catalog). Not client data; maker-checker and roles apply.
categories.STAFF_ADMIN_SECURITY: Staff identity, sessions, MFA recovery, membership, audit centre and security events. Administrator or own-session checks; not client records.
categories.MANAGER_ONLY: Refused unless the actor is a practice manager (or administrator), who is tenant-wide by design.
categories.OWN_RECORDS: Returns or changes only records tied to the actor themselves (their own assignments, tasks they created or are assigned, documents they uploaded).
categories.CLIENT_SELF: For the client's own portal account: the actor must be the client member of that client. Staff paths, where they exist, are noted in the reason.
categories.CLIENT_LEVEL_BY_DESIGN: Client-level records with no engagement or tax year (Stage 01 onboarding identity, chart of accounts, bank feeds, notifications, consultations, reassignment requests), recorded as client-level by design in the Phase 14 dossier.
categories.OWNER_DECISION_PENDING: Messaging, appointments, rooms and legal matters: still decided per client until the owner decides how general (engagement-less) records are shared (phase14-remaining-domain-access-policy.md).
categories.CODEX_HANDOFF: Billing: invoice records carry an engagement, but taxguard_bill_* is redefined by Codex's Phase 15 work; engagement scope belongs in those definitions (phase14-phase15-billing-overlap.md).
categories.STAFF_CLIENT_LEVEL_REVIEW: Finding recorded by Block 79: the staff path is client-level (any active assignment to the client) and returns status-level data of every engagement or year. Follow-up: scope it like the practice client detail (20261018100000).
